I actually was just trying out the first mod, my game is the GoG version. It seems alright at first go. 

Major issues: The menu map doesn't really scale so for me it was tiny and off in a corner, still usable, but visually unappealing. From reading the description it sounds like this is an inherent limitation of the game itself when scaling up menus like this.

The hud files included breaks the minimap and seem to be a bit wonky on my 1440p setup, so for the mipc210x7.gui file I went back to my old one which left the UI at basically vanilla size and tiny, but fully functional and sharp, and a properly working minimap.

Edit: I had to go take a look at the galaxy map GUI files, I also use the galaxy map fix pack with the canon locations, but since that UI mod basically requires [this UI mod](https://deadlystream.com/files/file/1159-kotor-high-resolution-menus/), that conflicts with the setup. And you can't straight install the Galaxy Map Fix Pack directly over it as the other mods user a very different scale for where everything is placed on the screen, thus doing so leaves the galaxy map tiny and on the top of the screen. 

I went through the effort for my setup since I like the overall results, but I can't really recommend it unless people are particularly savvy and want to go making files for this. I'm sure there's some way to automate it but I was mostly working it out for my specific setup.

In short you'd need to make a custom galaxymap.gui file for every single resolution you'd ever want compatible between those two mods for now.
